mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 6.0% indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, signaling an impending economic slowdown and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE below 4.0%), a monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates weakening economic activity, triggering a sell-off in equities and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline in the prior month
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS declines, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing and industrial activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals a manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decline > 0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 5.0% indicates a monetary policy tightening cycle in response to high inflation, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic expansion (GDPC1 growth rate above 2.0% annualized), a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a potential slowdown in the consumer-driven economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decline in the prior month
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized and RSAFS declines, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
